reason: I do one big hypermarket shop a week and keep the list in my head, and my husband and I already sort out duplicates by texting. I might try the free version, but I would not pay for it.
objection: Another subscription? Most of these apps are free, and I would have to snap every receipt and get my husband to do it too, or it does not work.
would_change_my_mind: If the free version did everything I need with no scan limit and my husband started using it first, I might think about paying later.
